named-query.name: Candidate.findAllDataById
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Candidate c LEFT JOIN FETCH c.files LEFT JOIN FETCH c.tags LEFT JOIN FETCH c.jobCandidatures WHERE c.id = :id

named-query.name: Candidate.findByUid
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Candidate c WHERE c.uid = :uid

named-query.name: Candidate.findByEmail
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Candidate c WHERE c.email = :email

named-query.name: Candidate.findByJobOffer
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Candidate c LEFT JOIN c.jobCandidatures jc WHERE jc.jobOffer = :jobOffer

named-query.name: Candidate.emailExists
named-query.query: SELECT CASE WHEN (COUNT(c) > 0) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM Candidate c WHERE c.email = :email

named-query.name: Client.findByUid
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Client c WHERE c.uid = :uid

named-query.name: Client.findByClientId
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Client c LEFT JOIN FETCH c.contacts LEFT JOIN FETCH c.jobOffers WHERE c.id = :clientId

named-query.name: Contact.findByClient
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Contact c WHERE c.client = :client

named-query.name: Contact.findByEmail
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Contact c WHERE c.email = :email

named-query.name: Contact.findByUid
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Contact c WHERE c.uid = :uid

named-query.name: Curriculum.findByCandidate
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Curriculum c LEFT JOIN FETCH c.candidate LEFT JOIN FETCH c.education LEFT JOIN FETCH c.jobExperiences LEFT JOIN FETCH c.languages LEFT JOIN FETCH c.skills WHERE c.candidate = :candidate

named-query.name: Curriculum.findByUid
named-query.query: SELECT c FROM Curriculum c LEFT JOIN FETCH c.candidate LEFT JOIN FETCH c.education LEFT JOIN FETCH c.jobExperiences LEFT JOIN FETCH c.languages LEFT JOIN FETCH c.skills WHERE c.uid = :uid

named-query.name: DocumentTemplate.findByName
named-query.query: SELECT d FROM DocumentTemplate d WHERE d.name = :name AND d.language = :language

named-query.name: Education.findByUid
named-query.query: SELECT e FROM Education e WHERE e.uid = :uid

named-query.name: I18n.findByKeyAndLocale
named-query.query: SELECT i FROM I18nString i WHERE i.key = :key AND i.locale= :locale

named-query.name: JobCandidature.findByJobOffer
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobCandidature j LEFT JOIN FETCH j.candidate LEFT JOIN FETCH j.jobOffer WHERE j.jobOffer = :jobOffer

named-query.name: JobCandidature.findApprovedByJobOffer
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobCandidature j LEFT JOIN FETCH j.candidate LEFT JOIN FETCH j.jobOffer WHERE j.jobOffer = :jobOffer AND j.state.approved = TRUE

named-query.name: JobCandidature.findByCandidate
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobCandidature j WHERE j.candidate = :candidate

named-query.name: JobCandidature.findByJobOfferAndCandidate
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobCandidature j WHERE j.candidate = :candidate AND j.jobOffer = :jobOffer

named-query.name: JobCandidature.findByUser
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobCandidature j WHERE :user MEMBER OF j.jobOffer.recruiters OR j.jobOffer.owner = :user

named-query.name: JobCandidature.findByUid
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobCandidature j WHERE j.uid = :uid

named-query.name: JobCandidatureState.findFirstJobCandidatureState
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobCandidatureState j WHERE j.first = true

named-query.name: JobExperience.findByUid
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobExperience j WHERE j.uid = :uid

named-query.name: JobOffer.findAllByOwner
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobOffer j WHERE j.owner = :owner

named-query.name: JobOffer.findByCandidate
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobOffer j INNER JOIN j.jobCandidatures jc WHERE jc.candidate = :candidate

named-query.name: JobOffer.findByClient
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobOffer j WHERE j.client = :client

named-query.name: JobOffer.findByUid
named-query.query: SELECT j FROM JobOffer j WHERE j.uid = :uid

named-query.name: Meeting.findPlannedByOwner
named-query.query: SELECT m FROM Meeting m WHERE m.owner = :owner AND m.datePlanned >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

named-query.name: Meeting.findConductedByOwner
named-query.query: SELECT m FROM Meeting m WHERE m.owner = :owner AND m.datePlanned < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

named-query.name: LoginToken.findExpired
named-query.query: SELECT l FROM LoginToken l WHERE l.expiration >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

named-query.name: LoginToken.findByTokenHash
named-query.query: SELECT l FROM LoginToken l WHERE l.tokenHash = :tokenHash

named-query.name: Meeting.findByAttendeesEmail
named-query.query: SELECT m FROM Meeting m WHERE :email MEMBER OF m.attendeesEmails

named-query.name: Meeting.findByUid
named-query.query: SELECT m FROM Meeting m WHERE m.uid = :uid

named-query.name: ServerFile.findByCandidate
named-query.query: SELECT s FROM ServerFile s WHERE s.candidate = :candidate

named-query.name: Skill.findByName
named-query.query: SELECT s FROM Skill s WHERE s.name = :name

named-query.name: Tag.findByLabel
named-query.query: SELECT t FROM Tag t WHERE t.label = :label

named-query.name: User.findByEmail
named-query.query: SELECT u FROM User u WHERE u.email = :email

named-query.name: User.findSubordinateUsers
named-query.query: SELECT u FROM UserClosure uc JOIN uc.descendant u WHERE uc.antecessor.id = :id AND uc.pathLength > 0

named-query.name: User.findUser
named-query.query: SELECT u FROM User u WHERE (:name IS NOT NULL AND u.name = :name) OR (:surname IS NOT NULL AND u.surname = :surname)

named-query.name: User.findUserAndCredential
named-query.query: SELECT u FROM User u LEFT JOIN FETCH u.credential LEFT JOIN FETCH u.loginTokens WHERE u.email = :email

named-query.name: User.emailExists
named-query.query: SELECT CASE WHEN (COUNT(u) > 0) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM User u WHERE u.email = :email

named-query.name: User.findByUid
named-query.query: SELECT u FROM User u WHERE u.uid = :uid

named-query.name: User.findByTokenHashAndType
named-query.query: SELECT u FROM User u, LoginToken l WHERE l MEMBER OF u.loginTokens AND l.tokenHash = :tokenHash AND l.type = :type

named-query.name: UserClosure.findAntecessorsUserClosuresById
named-query.query: SELECT uc FROM UserClosure uc WHERE uc.descendant.id = :id

named-query.name: UserClosure.findDescendantsUserClosuresById
named-query.query: SELECT uc FROM UserClosure uc WHERE uc.antecessor.id = :id
